criteria.text: Diagnosis of treatment-resistant depression or MDD with acute suicidal ideation or behavior.
Prescribed by or in consultation with a psychiatrist (approval criterion 2).
Documentation of at least one baseline depression score: HAMD17, QIDS-C16, MADRS, BDI or PHQ-9 (approval criterion 3).
Administered under direct supervision of a healthcare provider (approval criterion 4).
Blood pressure assessed before and after each administration (approval criterion 5).
Trial, failure or contraindication to two distinct listed antidepressant classes taken for ≥8 weeks each: SSRI, SNRI, serotonin modulators, aminoketone, NaSSA, TCA or MAOI (approval criterion 6).

Tried and failed ≥1 antidepressant augmentation therapy for ≥8 weeks (e.g. antidepressant plus second-generation antipsychotic or lithium, or two concurrent antidepressants with different mechanisms of action) (approval criterion 7).
Prescriber enrolled in Spravato REMS (approval criterion 8).
Aneurysmal vascular disease (thoracic/abdominal aorta, intracranial or peripheral arterial vessels) or arteriovenous malformation (denial criterion 2).
Prescriber attests benefits of Spravato outweigh risks; required independently of psychosis history (denial criterion 4).

notes: Partial encoding from Alaska Medicaid Spravato Criteria Version 2; effective 2023-01-02; Updated 6/26/2026. Approval criteria 1–8 and denial criteria 2–4 encoded as shared gates for both closed indications. Denial criterion 1 is failure to meet approval criteria.

Baseline score documentation and step therapy are attestations requiring chart verification. The antidepressant class attestation requires two distinct listed classes and ≥8 weeks each; augmentation requires ≥1 tried and failed therapy for ≥8 weeks. No numeric baseline score threshold is specified.
FDA usage (notes only): TRD in adults as monotherapy or with an oral antidepressant; MDD with acute suicidal ideation or behavior in adults in conjunction with an oral antidepressant.

Limitations (notes only): effectiveness in preventing suicide or reducing suicidal ideation or behavior has not been demonstrated; hospitalization may still be clinically warranted despite improvement. Not approved as an anesthetic; safety and effectiveness as an anesthetic are not established.

Cautions (notes only): cardiovascular/cerebrovascular conditions and risk factors may increase adverse effects. May impair attention, judgment, thinking, reaction speed and motor skills; do not drive or operate machinery until the next day after restful sleep. May cause fetal harm; consider pregnancy planning and prevention in females of reproductive potential.
Duration (notes only): initial approval 3 months; reauthorization 12 months with chart notes showing improvement from the baseline depression score.

Quantity (notes only): 8 × 56mg dose kits/month or 8 × 84mg dose kits/month; maximum 84mg twice weekly. Physician administered claims HCPCS J0013 (max 84 HCPCS per treatment). Pharmacy Point-of-Sale payment as of October 2022. max_units is null; quantity is not evaluated.
Documentation verification, FDA usage, limitations, cautions, duration, reauthorization and quantity require manual review; this pack remains partial.
